w01.core_product_service: Precision machined and fabricated metal parts; CNC milling, turning, and waterjet cutting services
w01.sells_vs_produces_note: Loughmiller sells precision machined and fabricated parts; it produces them through CNC milling, turning, waterjet cutting, and related in-house machining processes.

w02.core_product_service: Heavy steel fabricated assemblies and precision machined components; specialized machinery such as moveable bridge systems
w02.sells_vs_produces_note: Steward Machine sells heavy fabricated steel assemblies and precision-machined components with full turnkey assembly; it produces them through in-house fabrication, welding, stress relieving, machining, and gear cutting.

w03.core_product_service: 40mm grenade ammunition and fuzes in multiple configurations; precision fuzes, firing devices, impact switches, and initiators

w03.sells_vs_produces_note: AMTEC sells finished 40mm grenade ammunition and fuzes; it produces them through in-house explosive manufacturing, metal forming, plating, precision assembly, and loading operations.

w04.core_product_service: Offset and digital printing press machinery; printing equipment, maintenance products, and cloud-based printing services

w05.core_product_service: Precision progressive stamped metal components and deep draw stamped parts for automotive and aerospace applications

c13.core_product_service: Micro-purchasing and rapid fulfillment services for federal government credit card transactions
